findings.headline: unquoted command arguments can be split
findings.body:
Problem: the command receives split arguments.

| input | result |
| --- | --- |

```bash
printf "%s" "$value"
```

findings.headline: direct command execution bypasses the review boundary
findings.body: Breakage: a direct command is executed without the expected wrapper.

findings.headline: caller context is not preserved
findings.body: The caller context is lost before the helper is invoked.
